name: kite-portfolio-analysis
description: AI-powered portfolio analysis for Zerodha Kite — benchmark comparison, Weinstein stage classification, concall AI summaries, and rebalancing recommendations.

tools.name: analyse_portfolio
tools.description: Full portfolio analysis: fetches live Kite holdings, computes returns vs benchmarks (Nifty 50/500/Smallcap 250/MF), classifies each holding by Weinstein stage using 50/150/200 MA, fetches concall AI summaries from trusted sources, and generates a rebalancing plan. Outputs a 4-tab HTML report to ~/Desktop.

module.description: Which analysis module to run. 'performance' = benchmark comparison only. 'stage' = stage classification + concall summaries only. 'both' = full review (default).

period.description: Primary period for benchmark comparison. Defaults to 'all' (shows 1M/3M/6M/1Y simultaneously).

tools.name: portfolio_performance
tools.description: Compares portfolio returns vs Nifty 50, Nifty 500, Nifty Smallcap 250, Parag Parikh Flexi Cap (Direct), and Nippon India Small Cap (Direct) for 1M/3M/6M/1Y periods. Uses live Kite historical data. Outputs Tab 1 (Overview) and Tab 2 (Performance) of the HTML report.

from_date.description: Start date for analysis in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today minus 365 days.

tools.name: portfolio_stage_analysis
tools.description: Classifies each holding by Weinstein stage (1=Basing, 2=Uptrend, 3=Topping, 4=Downtrend) using 50/150/200-day moving averages computed from live Kite candle data. Also fetches earnings and concall summaries from whitelisted sources. Outputs Tab 3 (Stage Analysis) and Tab 4 (Rebalancing) of the HTML report.

stocks.description: Optional list of specific tradingsymbols to analyse (e.g. ['TATAELXSI', 'APOLLOHOSP']). Defaults to all holdings.

mf_benchmarks.flexicap: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund — Direct Plan
mf_benchmarks.smallcap: Nippon India Small Cap Fund — Direct Plan
